summary: This Form 8-K filed by Expro Group Holdings N.V. reports the company's Q1 2026 earnings results (Item 2.02), discloses investor presentation materials (Item 7.01), and provides an update on a proposed redomicile from the Netherlands to the Cayman Islands (Item 8.01), noting that the SEC declared the S-4 effective on April 21, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings and regulatory disclosure; there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation event. The redomicile is a corporate structural change, not a going-private or tender offer. The filing does not contain deal terms or reflect an event-driven catalyst.
